results.author: VitalSun
results.text:
Your kid's eyes may be taking permanent damage right now, and glasses do not fix it.

Nearsightedness, or myopia, is when distant things go blurry while close things stay sharp. Most people assume that just means the eye needs a stronger lens.

But that is not what is happening
